title: Full Machine Variability Sweep — Every Machine × Material × Tool × Holder × Fixture × Controller
description: Comprehensive testing of ALL 15 shop-floor machines with maximum variability. Tests every combination of material ISO groups, cutting tools, tool holders, fixtures, controller features, and print/program references. Organized by machine type: lathes first, then mills, sinker EDMs, wire EDMs. This milestone is now explicitly the JM Die proving-ground envelope for validating PRISM against a real shop.
notes: JM Die is the canonical PRISM development and test shop. Do not start broad variability execution until the JM Die company profile plus machine, controller, holder, tooling, material, and print/program master data have been seeded from H:/PRISM/JM DIE and published through MCAT-MS0 and APPW machine-workspace surfaces.

canonical_company_profile.name: JM Die
canonical_company_profile.role: Primary proving ground for full-shop variability validation

prerequisites: MCAT-MS0 publishes JM Die-backed machine, controller, holder, tooling, material, and print/program master data
APPW-MS8 U-APPW41/U-APPW41A expose routed machine workspaces and selector authority against that same JM Die truth
EMP-MS0 seeds the JM Die employee and certification system of record for operator-facing validation where required

variability_targets.controllers: 7 families (Okuma OSP, Haas NGC, Hurco WinMax, Fanuc 31i, Mitsubishi EDM)
variability_targets.fixtures: Chucks, collets, vises, tombstones, vacuum, magnetic
variability_targets.prints: JM Die print/program corpus spanning CNC LATHE, WIRE EDM, ROKU-ROKU, and JM DIE COMPANY assets

LATHE-L1.title: Okuma Genos L300-M (OSP-P300L-R) — Live Tooling Lathe

units.title: Machine profile + controller registration
units.description: Register Genos L300-M: max RPM 5000, 25HP spindle, 10-inch chuck, 12-station turret, live tooling C-axis. OSP-P300L-R controller with G/M codes, macro variables, rigid tapping. Create machine-handbook JSON if missing.

units.title: Material sweep — all ISO groups for turning
units.description: Test S/F calculation for L300-M across: P steels (1018, 4140, 4340, 8620, 1045, D2, H13, A2), M stainless (304, 316, 17-4PH, 15-5PH), K cast iron (GG25, GG30, ductile), N non-ferrous (6061, 7075, 2024, brass C360, copper), S superalloys (IN718, IN625, Ti-6Al-4V, Hastelloy, Waspaloy), H hardened (>45HRC). Verify kc1.1, mc, Vc, force, power for each.

units.title: Turning tool sweep — OD/ID/face/groove/thread/part-off
units.description: Test all turning tool types: CNMG/WNMG/DNMG inserts for OD, boring bars for ID (S20S-MCLNR, A16R-SCLCR), face grooving (KGDF/KGDR), cut-off (N151.2), threading (266RG), knurling. Verify insert grade selection per material. Test with Sandvik, Kennametal, Iscar, Tungaloy holders.

units.title: Live tooling sweep — milling/drilling on C-axis
units.description: Test live tooling: endmills (6-16mm), drills (3-12mm), taps (M4-M12), cross-drilling, keyway milling. Verify C-axis positioning, Y-axis if available. Test ER32 collet holders for live tools.

units.title: Fixture sweep — chucks, collets, steady rests
units.description: Test workholding: 3-jaw chuck (OD grip, ID grip), collet chucks (5C, 16C, 65mm), steady rest (follower, fixed), live center tailstock, face driver. Verify jaw pressure, clamping force vs material.

LATHE-L2.title: Okuma Genos L200E-M (OSP-P200LA-R) — Economy Live Tooling

units.title: Machine profile + controller registration
units.description: Register Genos L200E-M: compact footprint, 8-inch chuck, 12-station turret, live tooling. OSP-P200LA-R controller. Create machine-handbook JSON. Compare capabilities vs L300-M.

units.title: Material + tool sweep (P/M/N groups)
units.description: Focus on production turning materials: P steels (1018, 4140, 1045), M stainless (304, 316), N aluminum (6061, 7075). Test CNMG/WNMG inserts, boring bars, threading. Verify power limits vs L300-M.

units.title: Economy vs performance comparison
units.description: Compare L200E-M vs L300-M for same part/material combos. Verify spindle power derating, max RPM limits, turret station restrictions. Document capability gaps.

units.title: Machine profile + legacy controller registration
units.description: Register LNC8: older Okuma lathe, 2-axis only, no live tooling. LNC controller (older generation). Create machine-handbook JSON. Document controller limitations vs modern OSP.

units.title: Material + tool sweep — turning only
units.description: Test pure turning operations: OD roughing/finishing, ID boring, facing, grooving, threading, parting. Materials: 1018, 4140, 304, 6061, brass. Verify older controller G-code format differences.

LATHE-L4.title: Okuma Crown L1060 (OSP-U10L) — Legacy Precision Lathe

units.title: Machine profile + OSP-U10L controller registration
units.description: Register Crown L1060: precision lathe, OSP-U10L (older OSP generation). Document max RPM, spindle power, chuck size, bar capacity. Create machine-handbook JSON.

units.title: Precision turning sweep — finishing passes
units.description: Focus on finish turning: tight tolerances, Ra <1.6um surface finish. Materials: 4140 QT, 304, 6061-T6. Tools: VBMT/DCMT finishing inserts, wiper inserts. Verify S/F for finishing vs roughing.

units.title: Machine profile + controller registration
units.description: Register Genos L400II-E: heavy-duty, large swing/bar capacity, OSP-P300LA-E. Document max turning diameter, spindle bore, turret stations. Create machine-handbook JSON.

units.title: Heavy roughing sweep — large diameter, deep cuts
units.description: Test heavy material removal: large bar stock (2-6 inch), deep DoC (3-8mm), high feed roughing. Materials: 4140, 4340, 1045, ductile iron. Tools: CNMG 432/542 for heavy roughing. Verify power consumption vs spindle limits.

units.title: Large part fixture sweep
units.description: Test workholding for large parts: 12+ inch chuck, soft jaws, face plates, between-centers. Verify steady rest requirements for long shafts. Test tailstock force calculations.

LATHE-L6.title: Okuma LB 3000EX Big Bore Static (OSP P500) — Production Lathe

units.title: Machine profile + OSP P500 controller registration
units.description: Register LB 3000EX Big Bore Static: big bore spindle (4+ inch), static tools only, OSP P500 (latest generation). Document max RPM at different chuck sizes, spindle power curve, bar capacity.

units.title: Big bore material sweep — tubes, pipes, large ID work
units.description: Test big bore applications: tube turning (1-4 inch ID), pipe threading, large ID boring. Materials: 1018 DOM tubing, 4130 chrome-moly, 304 SS tubing, 6061 tubing. Verify ID tooling reach and clearance.

units.title: OSP P500 advanced features
units.description: Test OSP P500 controller features: thermal compensation, collision avoidance, tool life management, adaptive feed control. Compare vs older OSP generations (P300, U10L).

units.title: Machine profile + OSP-P300SA multi-axis registration
units.description: Register Multus B250II: B-axis milling head, C-axis, Y-axis, sub-spindle capable. OSP-P300SA controller. Document 5-axis simultaneous capability, ATC specs, live tool specs.

units.title: Full material sweep — turning + milling combos
units.description: Test combined operations per material: OD turn → mill flat → drill cross hole → thread. Materials: 4140, 4340, 304, 316, Ti-6Al-4V, IN718, 6061, 7075. Verify tool change strategy and cycle time.

units.title: B-axis milling sweep — angular features
units.description: Test B-axis: angular drilling, compound angle milling, 3+2 positioning, simultaneous 5-axis. Tools: endmills 6-20mm, drills 3-16mm, face mills. Verify RTCP/TCP positioning.

units.title: Multi-axis holder + fixture sweep
units.description: Test: Capto C6 tooling system, ER collet holders, Sandvik turning holders, BMT65 for live tools, hydraulic chucks, soft jaws, sub-spindle gripping. Verify tool change time and holder clearance.

units.title: Machine profile + WinMax controller registration
units.description: Register VM30i: 12000 RPM, 25HP, CAT40, 30x16x20 travel, 24-pocket ATC, WinMax v10.3.0.11467 conversational + NC. Create machine-handbook JSON with exact specs.

units.title: Full material sweep — all ISO groups for milling
units.description: Test S/F for all materials: P steels (1018-D2 range), M stainless (304, 316, 17-4), K cast iron (GG25, ductile), N aluminum (6061, 7075, brass), S superalloys (Ti-6Al-4V, IN718), H hardened (>45HRC). Verify force/power vs 25HP limit.

units.title: Tool sweep — endmills, drills, taps, face mills
units.description: Test all milling tool types: flat endmills (3-25mm), ball endmills (6-16mm), bull nose (8-20mm), drills (1-25mm), taps (M3-M20), reamers, face mills (50-80mm), chamfer mills. Test carbide, HSS, indexable. Verify chip thinning, HEM speed boost.

units.title: Holder sweep — CAT40 packages
units.description: Test all CAT40 holder types: shrink fit (HAIMER), hydraulic (Schunk TENDO), collet (ER32/ER40), side-lock, Weldon, shell mill arbor. Compare TIR, stiffness, speed derating per holder. Test with BIG KAISER, Kennametal, REGO-FIX brands.

units.title: Fixture sweep — vises, clamps, plates
units.description: Test workholding: Kurt DX6 vise, Orange Vise, 5-axis fixture plate, t-slot clamping, vacuum table, magnetic chuck. Verify clamping force, part accessibility, chip evacuation.

units.title: Machine profile + OSP P300MA-H 5-axis registration
units.description: Register Genos M460V-5AX: trunnion table (A/C axes), 15000 RPM, BT40/CAT40, OSP P300MA-H. Document work envelope, tilt limits, table load capacity.

units.title: 5-axis material + tool sweep
units.description: Test 3+2 and simultaneous 5-axis across materials: aerospace (Ti-6Al-4V, IN718, 7075), medical (316L, CoCr, PEEK), mold (P20, H13, S7). Tools: ball endmills, tapered endmills, lollipop cutters, barrel cutters.

units.title: 5-axis holder + fixture sweep
units.description: Test compact holders for 5-axis clearance: HSK-A63, slim collet chucks, shrink fit, pencil-neck boring bars. Fixtures: 5-axis vises (Lang, Roemheld), tombstones, zero-point systems (Erowa, System 3R).

units.title: RTCP/TCP + collision avoidance testing
units.description: Test OSP P300MA-H RTCP: pivot length calibration, TCP positioning accuracy, tilted work plane G-codes. Verify collision zones, tool length compensation in tilted planes.

units.title: Machine profile + Pre-NGC controller registration
units.description: Register VF-2 Pre-NGC: 8100 RPM, 20HP, CAT40, 30x16x20 travel, 20-pocket ATC. Document Pre-NGC vs NGC differences: macro limits, look-ahead, surface finish settings.

units.title: Full material + tool sweep — production milling
units.description: Test production scenarios: 4140 roughing (25mm endmill, HEM), 6061 high-speed (16mm, 3F, full slot), 304 SS (12mm, 4F, trochoidal), cast iron (face mill 63mm). Verify 8100 RPM ceiling effect on small tools.

units.title: Pre-NGC controller limitations + workarounds
units.description: Document Pre-NGC limits: no high-speed look-ahead, limited macro variable count, G187 surface finish settings, M97/M98 subprograms. Test workaround strategies for each limitation.

MILL-M4.title: Haas OM-2 (Pre-NGC) — Office Mill / Small Parts

units.title: Machine profile + small-part optimization
units.description: Register OM-2: compact office mill, 15000 RPM, CAT40 or BT40, small work envelope. Document differences vs VF-2: higher RPM, smaller table, lower rigidity.

units.title: Small tool + precision material sweep
units.description: Test small tools (1-10mm endmills, micro drills) on: 6061, brass, Delrin, PEEK, 304 SS. Verify high-RPM S/F calculations for small diameters. Test with ER16/ER20 collet holders.

units.title: Fixture sweep — small part workholding
units.description: Test: precision vises (2-3 inch), collet blocks, V-blocks, vacuum plates, double-sided tape. Verify clamping force adequate for small parts without deformation.

units.title: Machine profile + Fanuc 31i-B5 + robot cell registration
units.description: Register HC 658-II: high-speed graphite/hardened steel VMC, Fanuc 31i-B5, mated to System 3R WorkPartner 1+ robot cell. Document pallet changer, electrode magazine, part loading automation.

units.title: Graphite electrode milling sweep
units.description: Test graphite electrode machining: POCO EDM-3, EDM-200, Toyo Tanso. Tools: ball endmills (0.5-6mm), diamond-coated, PCD. Verify dust extraction requirements, surface finish for EDM.

units.title: Hardened steel milling sweep — mold/die
units.description: Test hardened steel (>48 HRC): D2, H13 hardened, S7, A2. Tools: AlTiN coated carbide, CBN endmills. Verify force limits, tool life predictions, surface finish achievable.

units.title: Robot cell automation sweep
units.description: Test System 3R integration: electrode ID tracking, pallet loading G-code (M-codes for robot), queue management, tool life + electrode wear tracking. Verify Fanuc 31i-B5 macro programming for robot handshake.

units.title: Fixture sweep — System 3R pallets + holders
units.description: Test System 3R: MacroMagnum chuck, Macro HP pallet, reference rail, electrode holders (20mm, 50mm, macro), part pallets. Verify repeatability specs and zero-point accuracy.

units.title: Machine profile + FP80S controller registration
units.description: Register EA12S: single-head sinker EDM, FP80S controller, tank size, axis travels, max workpiece weight. Document generator specs, flushing system, electrode changer capacity.

units.title: Material × electrode sweep — all sinker EDM combos
units.description: Test sinker EDM material combinations: copper electrodes on D2/H13/S7/A2/carbide. Graphite electrodes on same. Test rough/semi/finish conditions per combo. Verify undercut, overburn, surface finish Ra.

units.title: Electrode geometry + wear compensation
units.description: Test electrode shapes: simple round, rectangular, complex form, thin rib. Verify orbiting parameters, electrode wear ratio, Z-axis compensation. Test multi-electrode strategies.

units.title: Machine profile + C30EA-2 dual-head registration
units.description: Register EA12D: dual-head sinker EDM, C30EA-2 controller. Document dual-head operation modes (independent, synchronized), axis config per head.

units.title: Dual-head productivity sweep
units.description: Test dual-head scenarios: two cavities simultaneously, rough+finish on different electrodes, parallel vs sequential. Compare cycle times vs EA12S single-head.

units.title: Controller comparison — C30EA-2 vs FP80S
units.description: Compare C30EA-2 vs FP80S: technology database differences, power supply differences, adaptive control features, remote monitoring. Document migration path between controllers.

EDM-W1.title: Mitsubishi FA10S — Wire EDM Multi-Controller × Multi-Wire

units.title: Machine profile + 3 controller registrations
units.description: Register FA10S with all 3 controllers: W21FAS-2, W30FAS-2, W31MV-2. Document differences: power supply generation, technology database version, axis speed, taper capability, submerged cutting support.

units.title: Wire type sweep — MD+ ProII vs MV1200S
units.description: Test both wire types across same parts: MD+ ProII (standard brass, 0.010 inch), MV1200S (zinc-coated, better flushing). Compare: cutting speed, surface finish, wire break frequency, cost per hour.

units.title: Material × thickness sweep — full matrix
units.description: Test WEDM across materials and thicknesses: D2 (0.5-6 inch), H13 (0.5-4 inch), A2 (0.5-3 inch), S7, carbide (0.25-2 inch), 304 SS (0.5-3 inch), 6061 Al (0.5-2 inch), Ti-6Al-4V (0.5-2 inch), copper-tungsten. For each: rough, skim 1, skim 2, skim 3.

units.title: Taper + 4-axis sweep
units.description: Test taper cutting: 0-30 degree taper on D2/H13, 4-axis independent UV for draft angles, taper accuracy at different heights. Test each controller's taper capability limits.

units.title: Controller comparison matrix — W21 vs W30 vs W31
units.description: Build comparison matrix: technology database depth, power supply (V350 vs older), auto-threading reliability, core removal features, programming differences (G-code variations). Document which controller is best for each scenario.

units.title: Fixture + workholding sweep — WEDM specific
units.description: Test WEDM fixtures: Mitsubishi EROWA interface, magnetic chucks (submerged), precision vises (Hirschmann), dedicated WEDM fixture plates, start hole locations. Verify submerge level, flushing nozzle clearance.
